vulnerability_mechanism.evidence: Independent replay of the published liquidjs@10.25.4 package with Liquid({root:[emptyTempDir]}).renderFile('/etc/hosts') returned the exact file contents. At v10.25.4 Parser uses LookupType.Root, Loader.lookup sets enforceRoot = type !== LookupType.Root, and therefore skips contains() while candidates() yields path.resolve(root, absoluteFile), which resolves to the absolute file. The same replay against 10.25.5 rejected the lookup.

atomic_bic.evidence: 822ba0be0f1cfbedd50376aff8ac49eee71bd48c is the smallest surviving first-write of the explicit Root exemption: its loader diff passes type !== LookupType.Root into candidates() and gates both containment checks with !enforceRoot. Pickaxe for that predicate finds its addition at 822ba0b and later removal by the fix; subsequent 3cd024d and 529dd67e retained or relocated the same exemption.

immediate_parent_absence.evidence: The BIC has the single immediate parent a3455ebd0b207141c34630c0af44d917db2ca1dd. That parent has no type !== LookupType.Root predicate and requires referenced.startsWith(dir) for every candidate, so an absolute path outside an unrelated root is not yielded.

squash_member_decomposition.evidence: The BIC is a one-parent ordinary commit, not a merge or squash aggregate, so no BIC member decomposition is required. For fix lineage, reconstructable PR member 484ba7f07863735af65fc2eed8e51c311298bdba and landed squash f41c1fc02fe901598f3328118b42b13bc6bc9b04 share parent db4348507e6aa205ab2ba5e3fa273c40767e6764 and have identical trees; the landed commit is the release-line fix.

affected_fixed_release.evidence: 822ba0b is absent from v9.27.1, first contained by v9.28.0, and is an ancestor of v10.25.0 and v10.25.4. f41c1fc is not an ancestor of v10.25.4 and is an ancestor of v10.25.5; v10.25.5 release metadata names f41c1fc as the root-containment fix. Live GHSA metadata states affected <=10.25.4 and first patched 10.25.5. CVE.org is PUBLISHED but its <10.25.3 range conflicts with repository and GHSA evidence.

direct_fix_or_unpatched.evidence: f41c1fc02fe901598f3328118b42b13bc6bc9b04 directly removes the LookupType.Root exemption, applies contains() to every candidate, and adds absolute-outside-root rejection tests. Published 10.25.5 independently rejects the 10.25.4 PoC.

bic_only_ai_attribution.evidence: The raw 822ba0b commit object names Harttle as author and committer and contains no AI-related trailer or marker, supporting NOT_AI. Made-with: Cursor appears only on the 2026 fix member/squash and is excluded from BIC attribution.
